newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Cyprus-based group wins Russia's Svyazinvest stake.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus-based group wins Russia's Svyazinvest stake.

text.p: Cyprus-registered Mustcom Ltd won a tender for 25 percent plus one share in Russian telecoms holding company Svyazinvest with a bid of $1.875 billion, a Russian Federal Property Fund official said on Friday.

He said Mustcom had been set up by Moscow investment bank Renaissance Capital and two other entities. Earlier a spokesman for Russia's Uneximbank said the bank had won the stake in a consortium including its affiliates investment bank MFK (ICFI) and Interros Group, Renaissance Capital, and Germany's Deutsche Bank AG with a $1.8 billion bid. The starting price for the stake had been $1.18 billion.
